kernel_plan.phase1: Keep the verified FP32 Smooth/signed-H128/U and A4 rounding. Replace dense F.linear with a packed VQ weight consumer.
kernel_plan.weight_decoder: Load two uint8 indices per d4 vector; FP32 codeword addition; apply original ldexp(BF16 row gain, B32 exponent-127) in FP32; cast each decoded weight to BF16 before MMA.
kernel_plan.kernel: Tile-decode directly in registers/shared memory, BF16 Tensor Core MMA with FP32 accumulation and bias epilogue. Never materialize a full decoded weight in global memory.
kernel_plan.layout: Offline reorder indices for measured N/K tiles; K tile multiple of32 and d4 alignment; 4096-byte BF16 codebooks reusable per layer. Padding must preserve masked tails.
kernel_plan.phase2: Use measured Smooth/H/U/A4 cost to decide input-transform fusion; preserve operation order and separately validate changed floating-point accumulation.
kernel_plan.phase3: Consider INT8/INT4/FP4 only as a separately calibrated decoder; current arbitrary BF16 VQ values cannot be sent directly to integer MMA.
kernel_plan.acceptance: Full80 paired action replay plus saved full action/future anchor, actual compressed residency, profiler evidence of no full-weight decode, kernel and full-policy latency on the same GPU.
kernel_plan.limitation: No speedup is predicted from bit count. Large-M video GEMMs may be compute-bound; small-M action GEMMs and large-M video GEMMs need separate dispatch decisions.
